en.t: Hadrian is proclaimed Roman emperor, two days after Trajan's death
en.s: Hadrian ( HAY-dree-ən; born Publius Aelius Hadrianus, 24 January 76 – 10 July 138) was Roman emperor from 117 to 138. His form of address as Roman emperor was Imperator Caesar Traianus Hadrianus Augustus. Hadrian was born in Italica, in the present-day Andalusian province of Seville in southern Spain, an Italic settlement in Hispania Baetica; his gens Aelia came from the town of Hadria in central Italy.

zh.t: 图拉真去世两天后，哈德良被拥立为罗马皇帝
zh.s: 哈德良（英语读音：HAY-dree-ən；原名普布利乌斯·埃利乌斯·哈德里安努斯；76年1月24日—138年7月10日）于117年至138年担任罗马皇帝。他作为罗马皇帝的全称是“统帅恺撒·图拉真·哈德良·奥古斯都”。哈德良出生于伊塔利卡，即今西班牙南部安达卢西亚塞维利亚省境内；该地当时是西班牙贝提卡的一处意大利人聚居地。他的埃利乌斯氏族来自意大利中部的哈德里亚镇。

en.s: The Battle of the Adda River occurred in 490 between the Ostrogothic Forces under Theodoric and the remaining army of the Heruli and Sciri under Flavius Odoacer.

en.s: The Sack of Basra was the capture and looting of the Abbasid city of Basra by the Qarmatians of Bahrayn, and took place in August 923. It was the first of a series of Qarmatian attacks, that culminated in an invasion of Iraq in 927–928.

zh.s: 巴士拉劫掠是巴林卡尔马特派攻占并洗劫阿拔斯王朝城市巴士拉的事件，发生于923年8月。这是卡尔马特派一系列袭击中的第一次，后来这些袭击在927年至928年发展为对伊拉克的入侵。

en.s: The Battle of Maldon took place on 10 or 11 August 991 AD near Maldon beside the River Blackwater in Essex, England, during the reign of Æthelred the Unready. Earl Byrhtnoth and his thegns led the English against a Viking invasion. The battle ended in an Anglo-Saxon defeat. After the battle Archbishop Sigeric of Canterbury and the aldermen of the south-western provinces advised King Æthelred to buy off the Vikings rather than continue the armed struggle.

zh.s: 马尔登战役发生于公元991年8月10日或11日，地点在英格兰埃塞克斯郡马尔登附近、布莱克沃特河畔，当时正值“无谋者”埃塞尔雷德统治时期。比尔特诺斯伯爵和他的侍从率领英格兰军队抵御维京人入侵，最终战败。战后，坎特伯雷大主教西格里克以及西南诸省的长官建议埃塞尔雷德国王向维京人支付赎金，避免继续武装冲突。

en.s: Battle of Pleichfeld, in 1086, was the last major battle of the Saxon revolt of 1077–1088, a nobles' rebellion against the emperor Henry IV in the Holy Roman Empire. The battle was a victory for the rebel forces.

zh.s: 普莱希费尔德战役发生于1086年，是1077年至1088年萨克森叛乱中的最后一场重大战役。这场叛乱是神圣罗马帝国内反对皇帝亨利四世的贵族起义。战役以叛军获胜告终。

en.s: The battle of Zierikzee was a naval battle between a Flemish fleet and an allied Franco-Hollandic fleet which took place on 10 and 11 August 1304. The battle, fought near the town of Zierikzee, ended in a Franco-Holland victory. The battle is part of a larger conflict between the Count of Flanders and his French feudal lord, King Philip IV of France (1296–1305).

zh.s: 济里克泽海战是佛兰德舰队与法兰西—荷兰联军舰队之间的一场海战，于1304年8月10日至11日在济里克泽附近爆发。战斗以法兰西—荷兰联军获胜告终。这场海战属于一场更大冲突的一部分，交战双方是佛兰德伯爵和他的法国封君腓力四世（1296—1305年在位）。

en.t: The Great Famine of Europe becomes so dire that even the king of England has difficulties buying bread for himself and his entourage
en.s: The Great Famine of 1315–1317 (occasionally dated 1315–1322) was the first of a series of large-scale crises that struck parts of Europe early in the 14th century. Most of Europe (extending east to Poland and south to the Alps) was affected. The famine caused widespread population loss over an extended number of years, marking a clear end to the period of growth and prosperity from the 11th to the 13th centuries.

zh.t: 欧洲大饥荒严重到连英格兰国王都难以为自己和随从买到面包
zh.s: 1315—1317年欧洲大饥荒（有时将时间定为1315—1322年）是14世纪初冲击欧洲部分地区的一系列大规模危机中的首场。欧洲大部分地区受到影响，范围东至波兰、南至阿尔卑斯山。饥荒持续多年，造成大范围人口损失，标志着11至13世纪增长与繁荣时期明显结束。

en.s: The Battle of Dupplin Moor was fought between supporters of King David II of Scotland, the son of King Robert Bruce, and English-backed invaders supporting Edward Balliol, son of King John I of Scotland, on 11 August 1332. It took place a little to the south-west of Perth, Scotland, when a Scottish force commanded by Donald, Earl of Mar, estimated to have been stronger than 15,000 and possibly as many as 40,000 men, attacked a largely English force of 1,500 commanded by Balliol and Henry Beaumont, Earl of Buchan.

zh.s: 杜普林沼泽战役于1332年8月11日爆发，交战双方是苏格兰国王大卫二世（罗伯特·布鲁斯之子）的支持者，以及支持爱德华·巴里奥尔的英格兰扶持入侵军；巴里奥尔是苏格兰国王约翰一世之子。战场位于苏格兰珀斯西南不远处。唐纳德·马尔伯爵率领一支苏格兰军队进攻，兵力估计超过1.5万人，也可能多达4万人。巴里奥尔和布肯伯爵亨利·博蒙特率领的英格兰军队则约有1500人。

en.s: The Battle of the Vozha River (Russian: Битва на реке Воже, romanized: Bitva na reke Vozhe) was a battle during the Great Troubles, fought between the Principality of Moscow and Mamai's faction within the Golden Horde on 11 August 1378. Mamai sought to punish Dmitri Ivanovich of Moscow (who had not yet received his nickname Donskoy) for refusing to pay the tribute.

zh.s: 沃扎河战役（俄语：Битва на реке Воже，罗马化：Bitva na reke Vozhe）是大动乱时期的一场战斗，于1378年8月11日在莫斯科公国与金帐汗国马迈派势力之间爆发。马迈企图惩罚拒绝纳贡的莫斯科大公德米特里·伊万诺维奇；当时他还没有获得“顿斯科伊”这一称号。

en.s: The Battle of Otlukbeli was fought between the Aq Qoyunlu and the Ottoman Empire on 11 August 1473.

zh.s: 奥特卢克贝利战役于1473年8月11日爆发，交战双方是白羊王朝和奥斯曼帝国。

en.s: The Battle of Lava (Swedish: Striden vid Lava; Russian: Битва за лаву) occurred on 11 August 1657, when a Swedish force, under the command of Gustav Evertsson Horn, attacked a Russian ostrog at Lava. Horn, who had not been notified that Carl Gustaf Wrangel would not be able to support him, was not able to dislodge the Russians.

zh.s: 拉瓦战役（瑞典语：Striden vid Lava；俄语：Битва за лаву）发生于1657年8月11日。古斯塔夫·埃弗特松·霍恩率领瑞典军队袭击了拉瓦的俄军木堡。霍恩事先没有接到卡尔·古斯塔夫·弗兰格尔无法前来支援的消息，因此未能赶走俄军。

en.s: The siege of Itzehoe was initiated by Sweden on 6 August 1657, while chasing the retreating Danish army after the failed campaign in Bremen-Verden. Charles X Gustav, the king of Sweden, ordered the town to be bombarded into submission, which unintentionally led to massive fires breaking out in the city, forcing the defenders to withdraw on 11 August.

zh.s: 1657年8月6日，瑞典军队在布雷梅尔福德—费尔登战役失败后追击撤退中的丹麦军队，开始围攻伊策霍。瑞典国王卡尔十世·古斯塔夫下令炮轰该镇，迫使守军屈服；炮击意外引发大火，最终迫使守军于8月11日撤离。

en.s: The Battle of Seneffe was fought on 11 August 1674 between French army under the command of Louis II de Bourbon, Prince de Condé and the Dutch-German-Spanish army under William III of Orange. During the Franco-Dutch War, William III commanded a Dutch-German-Spanish army through the southern Netherlands into the territory of Northern France. France defended this area with an army under Louis II de Bourbon, Prince de Condé. For five weeks the two armies manoeuvred without getting into combat with each other. On the 10th of August, William III decided to head for Paris in order to force the enemy into fighting.

zh.s: 塞内夫战役于1674年8月11日爆发，交战双方是路易二世·德·波旁，孔代亲王率领的法军，以及奥兰治亲王威廉三世率领的荷兰—德意志—西班牙联军。法荷战争期间，威廉三世率领联军穿过南尼德兰，进入法国北部。法军由孔代亲王率领，负责防守该地区。两军机动了五周，始终没有交战。8月10日，威廉三世决定向巴黎进军，迫使敌军与其交战。

en.s: The Battle of Konzer Brücke (also: Consaarbrück) was fought as part of the Franco-Dutch War on 11 August 1675 and resulted in an Imperial victory.

zh.s: 孔泽桥战役又称孔萨布吕克战役，是法荷战争期间于1675年8月11日爆发的一场战斗，最终以帝国军队获胜告终。

en.s: The Battle of Eperjes (now: Prešov) was fought on August 11, 1685, near the city of Eperjes in the Kingdom of Hungary, between the forces of the Ottoman Empire, and the forces of the Holy Roman Empire as part of the Great Turkish War. The Habsburg army defeated the invading forces of Imre Thököly.

zh.s: 埃佩尔耶什战役（今普雷绍夫）于1685年8月11日在匈牙利王国埃佩尔耶什附近爆发，是大土耳其战争的一部分。交战双方是奥斯曼帝国和神圣罗马帝国军队。哈布斯堡军队击败了伊姆雷·特克伊率领的入侵部队。

en.s: The conquest of Coron of 1685 was the capture of the Ottoman fortress of Coron (Koroni) in the southwestern Morea (Peloponnese) by the Republic of Venice in 1685. It signalled the start of the Venetian conquest of the Morea during the Great Turkish War. Along with neighbouring Modon (Methoni), Coron had been strategically important Venetian bases until captured by the Ottomans in 1500.

zh.s: 1685年，威尼斯共和国攻占了摩里亚西南部（伯罗奔尼撒半岛）的奥斯曼科隆要塞（又称科罗尼）。此举标志着威尼斯在大土耳其战争期间开始征服摩里亚。科隆与邻近的莫东（梅索尼）曾是威尼斯具有重要战略意义的基地，直到1500年被奥斯曼帝国攻占。

en.s: The Battle of La Prairie was an attack made on the French colonial settlement of La Prairie, New France on August 11, 1691 by an English, Mohawk and Mohican force coming north from Albany, New York. The force, led by Major Pieter Schuyler, initially intended to attack Montreal, but was repulsed with significant casualties by the French and their Indian allies.

zh.s: 1691年8月11日，一支从纽约州奥尔巴尼北上的英格兰、莫霍克和莫希干联军袭击了新法兰西的法国殖民地拉普雷里。彼得·舒伊勒少校率领这支部队，原本打算进攻蒙特利尔，但遭到法国军队及其原住民盟友击退，并付出惨重伤亡。

en.t: Capture of the galleon San Joaquin
en.s: The capture of the galleon San Joaquin (also known as the Battle of Cartagena) was a naval engagement that took place off the coast near Cartagena (present day Colombia). It involved five British ships of the line against the Spanish galleon San Joaquin and a smaller ship. After an action lasting barely an hour San Joaquin surrendered.

zh.s: 俘获“圣华金”号大帆船又称卡塔赫纳海战，是发生在今哥伦比亚卡塔赫纳附近海域的一场海战。交战双方是五艘英国战列舰，以及西班牙大帆船“圣华金”号和一艘小型舰船。交战不到一小时，“圣华金”号便投降。

en.s: The Toggenburg War, also known as the Second War of Villmergen or the Swiss Civil War of 1712, was a Swiss civil war during the Old Swiss Confederacy from 12 April to 11 August 1712. The Catholic "inner cantons" and the Imperial Abbey of Saint Gall fought the Protestant cantons of Bern and Zürich as well as the abbatial subjects of Toggenburg.

zh.s: 托根堡战争又称第二次维尔默根战争或1712年瑞士内战，是旧瑞士邦联时期的一场内战，持续于1712年4月12日至8月11日。交战双方是天主教“内邦”和圣加仑帝国修道院，以及伯尔尼、苏黎世等新教邦和托根堡修道院领地的臣民。

en.s: The Battle of Cape Passaro (or Passero) was the defeat of a Spanish fleet under Admirals Antonio de Gaztañeta and Fernando Chacón by a British fleet under Admiral George Byng, near Cape Passero, Sicily, on 11 August 1718, four months before the War of the Quadruple Alliance was formally declared.

zh.s: 帕萨罗角海战又称帕塞罗海战。1718年8月11日，西班牙舰队在安东尼奥·德·加斯塔涅塔和费尔南多·查孔海军上将率领下，在西西里岛帕塞罗角附近被乔治·宾海军上将率领的英国舰队击败。此战发生在四国同盟战争正式宣战前四个月。

en.s: The Battle of Velletri were two battles between Austria and the Kingdom of Naples in 1744 during the War of the Austrian Succession around the city of Velletri, then part of the Papal States. The first battle took place in the night of 16–17 June 1744, when the Spanish-Neapolitan army launched a surprise attack and conquered 3 important hills.

zh.s: 1744年奥地利王位继承战争期间，奥地利与那不勒斯王国在韦莱特里市周围进行了两场战斗；当时该地属于教宗国。第一场战斗于1744年6月16日至17日夜间发生，西班牙—那不勒斯军队发动突袭并夺取了三座重要山丘。

en.s: The Battle of Delhi, 1757 was a battle fought on 11 August 1757 between Maratha Empire under the command of Raghunath Rao and Rohillas under Najib-ud-Daula, who was under the Afghan suzerainty. The battle was waged by the Marathas for the control of Delhi, the former Mughal capital which was now under the control of Rohilla chief Najib-ud-Daula, as a consequence of fourth invasion of Ahmad Shah Abdali.

zh.s: 1757年德里战役于1757年8月11日爆发，交战双方是拉古纳特·拉奥率领的马拉塔帝国军队，以及纳吉布·乌德·道拉率领、受阿富汗宗主权控制的罗希拉人。马拉塔人试图夺取德里。这座城市曾是莫卧儿帝国首都，当时由罗希拉首领纳吉布·乌德·道拉控制；其背景是艾哈迈德·沙阿·阿卜达利第四次入侵。

en.s: Penang is a Malaysian state located on the northwest coast of Peninsular Malaysia. It is divided into two parts by the Strait of Malacca: Penang Island to the west, where the capital city George Town is located, and Seberang Perai on the mainland Malay Peninsula to the east. These two halves are physically connected by the Penang Bridge and the Second Penang Bridge.

zh.s: 槟城是马来西亚的一个州，位于马来半岛西北海岸。马六甲海峡将其分成两部分：西侧的槟岛是首府乔治市所在地，东侧的威省位于马来半岛大陆。槟城大桥和第二槟城大桥连接了这两部分。

en.t: Captain Francis Light establishes the British colony of Penang in Malaysia
en.s: Francis Light (c. 1740 – 21 October 1794) was a British sailor and explorer best known for founding the colony of Penang and its capital city of George Town in 1786. Light was the father of William Light, who founded the city of Adelaide in South Australia in 1836.

zh.t: 弗朗西斯·莱特船长在马来西亚建立英国殖民地槟城
zh.s: 弗朗西斯·莱特（约1740年—1794年10月21日）是英国水手和探险家，以1786年建立槟城殖民地及其首府乔治市而闻名。莱特是威廉·莱特之父；威廉于1836年在南澳大利亚建立阿德莱德市。

en.s: The Battle of Cape Kaliakra (Kaliakria, Caliacria; Russian: Калиакрийское сражение) was the last naval battle of the Russo-Turkish War (1787–1792). It took place on 11 August 1791 off the coast of Cape Kaliakra, Bulgaria, in the Black Sea. Neither side lost a ship, but the Ottomans retreated to Istanbul afterwards.

zh.s: 卡利亚克拉角海战又称卡利亚克里亚海战或卡利亚克里亚角海战（俄语：Калиакрийское сражение），是1787年至1792年俄土战争期间最后一场海战。战斗于1791年8月11日在黑海保加利亚海岸的卡利亚克拉角附近爆发。双方均未损失舰船，但奥斯曼舰队随后撤退至伊斯坦布尔。

en.s: The Battle of Neresheim (11 August 1796) was fought by the Republican French army under Jean Victor Marie Moreau against the army of the Habsburg monarchy of Archduke Charles, Duke of Teschen. Pursued by Moreau's Army of Rhin-et-Moselle, Charles launched an attack against the French. While the Austrian left wing saw some success, the battle degenerated into a stalemate and the archduke withdrew further into the Electorate of Bavaria.

zh.s: 内雷斯海姆战役于1796年8月11日爆发，交战双方是让-维克托-马里·莫罗率领的共和法国军队，以及由特申公爵卡尔大公率领的哈布斯堡君主国军队。摩泽尔—莱茵军团追击莫罗军队期间，卡尔大公向法军发动进攻。奥军左翼一度取得进展，但战斗最终陷入僵局，大公随后撤入巴伐利亚选侯国。

en.s: The Battle of Almonacid was fought on 11 August 1809 during the Peninsular War between Sébastiani's IV Corps of the French Peninsular Army, which had withdrawn from the Battle of Talavera to defend Madrid, and the Spanish Army of La Mancha under General Venegas. After the decisive charges of Polish uhlans, the battle resulted in a French victory.

zh.s: 阿尔莫纳西德战役于1809年8月11日在半岛战争期间爆发。交战双方是法军半岛军团第四军团（由塞巴斯蒂亚尼指挥，该部队从塔拉韦拉战役撤退后前往防守马德里）和维内加斯将军率领的拉曼查西班牙军。波兰枪骑兵发起决定性冲锋后，法军获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Majadahonda (11 August 1812) saw an Imperial French cavalry division led by Anne-François-Charles Trelliard attack two brigades of cavalry under Benjamin D'Urban and forming the advance guard of Arthur Wellesley, Earl of Wellington's army. Trelliard's leading brigade routed D'Urban's Portuguese horsemen and overran three British cannons.

zh.s: 马哈达洪达战役于1812年8月11日爆发。安娜-弗朗索瓦-夏尔·特雷利亚尔率领的法兰西帝国骑兵师袭击了本杰明·德厄本指挥的两支骑兵旅；这两支部队是威灵顿伯爵阿瑟·韦尔斯利军队的前卫。特雷利亚尔的先头旅击溃了德厄本的葡萄牙骑兵，并夺取了三门英国火炮。

en.s: The Battle of Swolna (Svolna) took place 11 August 1812 near the village of Svolna – during the French invasion of Russia – where Oudinot's French ran at the river Svolna into the Russians under d'Auvray (Dovre).

zh.s: 斯沃尔纳战役又称斯沃尔纳河战役，于1812年8月11日在斯沃尔纳村附近爆发，当时正值法国入侵俄罗斯。乌迪诺率领的法军在斯沃尔纳河附近遭遇了由达夫雷（多夫雷）率领的俄军。

en.s: The Arikara War was a military conflict between the United States and Arikara in 1823 fought in the Great Plains along the Upper Missouri River in the Unorganized Territory (presently within South Dakota). For the United States, the war was the first in which the United States Army was deployed for operations west of the Missouri River on the Great Plains.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1823年，美国与阿里卡拉人爆发战争，战场位于大平原上密苏里河上游沿岸的未建制领地（今南达科他州境内）。这是美国陆军首次在密苏里河以西的大平原地区执行军事行动。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Praia Bay was fought by the coast of Terceira Island on August 11, 1829, between Portuguese liberals and a Miguelite fleet as part of the Portuguese civil war. The Miguelites under command of José António Azevedo e Lemos attempted to disembark troops on Terceira island, but were defeated by the liberal troops under command of the Duke of Terceira who controlled a dozen small forts and artillery batteries along five kilometers of the coast.

zh.t: 普拉亚达维多利亚战役
zh.s: 普拉亚湾战役于1829年8月11日在特塞拉岛海岸爆发，是葡萄牙内战期间自由派与米格尔派舰队之间的一场战斗。何塞·安东尼奥·阿泽维多·莱莫斯率领的米格尔派试图在特塞拉岛登陆，但被自由派击败。自由派由特塞拉公爵率领，控制着沿海五公里范围内的12座小型堡垒和炮兵阵地。

en.s: The Battle of Gordali was one of the fiercest battles of the Murid War, and by extension, the Caucasian War. The battle between the Separate Caucasian Corps of the Caucasian Army under the command of Colonel Baklanov and the Chechen troops under the leadership of Naibs Eski and Talkhig took place on August 11, 1852, near the village of Gurdali, located on the Michik River.

zh.s: 戈尔达利战役是穆里德战争中最激烈的战斗之一，也因此成为高加索战争的一部分。1852年8月11日，巴克拉诺夫上校率领的高加索军团独立军与埃斯基、塔尔希格两位纳伊卜率领的车臣部队，在米奇克河畔的古尔达利村附近交战。

en.s: The Bombardment of Sveaborg, also known as the Battle of Sveaborg, took place on 9–11 August 1855, between Russian defenders and a joint British–French fleet during the Åland War, a Baltic Sea theater of the Crimean War. British and French ships bombarded the Russian fortress of Sveaborg from beyond the range of the defenders' artillery. After 48 hours of bombardment, the attackers withdrew without attempting a landing.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 斯韦阿堡炮击战又称斯韦阿堡战役，于1855年8月9日至11日爆发，交战双方是俄军守军与英法联合舰队。该战役发生在奥兰战争期间，属于克里米亚战争的波罗的海战场。英法军舰在俄军炮火射程之外炮击斯韦阿堡俄军要塞。炮击持续48小时后，进攻方撤离，没有尝试登陆。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Egan Station (also known as Egan Canyon Station or Egan Canyon) was a minor skirmish which occurred near Schellbourne, Nevada in August 1860. A group of about 80 Paiute warriors attacked a Pony Express station in Egan Canyon looking for food. When the two civilians had gathered up all the food on hand the warrior's chief demanded they bake more bread.

zh.s: 伊根车站战役又称伊根峡谷车站战役或伊根峡谷冲突，是1860年8月在内华达州谢尔伯恩附近发生的一场小规模冲突。约80名派尤特族战士为寻找食物，袭击了伊根峡谷的一处驿马快信站。两名平民把手头所有食物拿出来后，战士首领又要求他们烤更多面包。

en.s: The Battle of Peña Colorado Creek was a small but major battle fought between the Mescalero Apache and the Confederate States of America that took place on August 11, 1861, near Marathon, Texas. The exact location of the battlefield is unknown but it was near the Peña Colorado Creek.

zh.t: 佩尼亚科罗拉多溪战役
zh.s: 佩尼亚科罗拉多溪战役是一场规模不大但意义重大的战斗，于1861年8月11日在得克萨斯州马拉松附近爆发，交战双方是梅斯卡莱罗阿帕奇人和美利坚联盟国。战场的确切位置不明，但在佩尼亚科罗拉多溪附近。

en.s: The Battle of Compton's Ferry (also known as Little Compton Ferry) was an action during the American Civil War, occurring August 11, 1862, along the Grand River in southwest Livingston County, Missouri. Colonel John A. Poindexter and his force of 1200 to 1500 Confederate recruits were caught at Compton Ferry along the Grand River by forces under Union Col. Odon Guitar. Here the Federals caught the rebels in the act of crossing the river, causing great havoc and sending them into headlong retreat. Two Union artillery pieces fired a total of eight rounds producing the rout. A large amount of materiel was recovered.

zh.s: 康普顿渡口战役又称小康普顿渡口战役，是美国内战期间的一场战斗，于1862年8月11日在密苏里州利文斯顿县西南部的大河沿岸爆发。约翰·A·波因德克斯特上校率领1200至1500名南方邦联新兵，在大河沿岸的康普顿渡口遭到奥登·吉他上校率领的联邦军袭击。联邦军趁叛军渡河时发起进攻，造成混乱并将其击溃，叛军仓皇撤退。两门联邦军火炮共发射八发炮弹，促成溃败。联邦军缴获了大量物资。

en.s: The First Battle of Independence was a minor engagement of the American Civil War, occurring on August 11, 1862, in the city of Independence, located in Jackson County, Missouri. Its result was a Confederate victory, continuing the Southern domination of the Jackson County area for a few days while the recruiters completed their work. This battle should not be confused with the Second Battle of Independence, which was fought in 1864.

zh.s: 独立镇第一次战役是美国内战期间的一场小规模战斗，于1862年8月11日在密苏里州杰克逊县独立镇发生。战斗以南方邦联获胜告终，南方势力因此在杰克逊县地区继续控制了几天，让征兵人员完成工作。此战不要与1864年发生的独立镇第二次战役混淆。

en.s: General elections were held in Belgium on 11 August 1864, the first full general elections since 1857. Although the Catholics received the most votes for seats in the Chamber of Representatives, the result was a victory for the Liberal Party, which won 64 of the 116 seats. Voter turnout was 76.7%, although only 103,717 people (2.1% of the population) were eligible to vote.

zh.s: 比利时于1864年8月11日举行大选，这是1857年以来首次举行完整的大选。天主教党在众议院席位选举中获得最多选票，但自由党赢得116席中的64席，最终获胜。投票率为76.7%，但只有103,717人（占总人口的2.1%）具备投票资格。

en.s: The Battle of Paso de Mercedes was fought on 11 August 1865 during the Paraguayan invasion of the Argentine province of Corrientes. The battle took place at Bella Vista along the Paraná River, west of Mercedes.

zh.s: 梅塞德斯隘口战役于1865年8月11日爆发，发生在巴拉圭入侵阿根廷科连特斯省期间。战斗地点是帕拉那河沿岸、梅塞德斯以西的贝拉维斯塔。

en.s: The Battle of Tuyú Cué was a minor Paraguayan ambush against the allied army's supply lines in August 1867, during the Paraguayan War. The Paraguayan troops, led by major Bernardino Caballero, managed to surprise a convoy and its guards, but were driven back after a quick allied reaction.

zh.s: 图尤库埃战役是1867年8月巴拉圭战争期间，巴拉圭军队对盟军补给线发动的一次小规模伏击。伯纳迪诺·卡瓦列罗少校率领的巴拉圭部队成功伏击了一支运输队及其护卫，但在盟军迅速反击后被击退。

en.s: The Stowmarket Guncotton Explosion happened on 11 August 1871 at the Prentices Guncotton Factory in Stowmarket, Suffolk. It was blown up by two massive explosions in the factory which killed 28 people and injured approximately 70 more.

zh.t: 斯托马基特棉火药厂爆炸
zh.s: 斯托马基特棉火药厂爆炸于1871年8月11日在萨福克郡斯托马基特的普伦蒂斯棉火药厂发生。厂内接连发生两起巨大爆炸，造成28人死亡、约70人受伤。

en.s: The Battle of Pease Bottom, also called the Battle of the Yellowstone was a conflict between the United States Army and the Sioux on August 11, 1873 along the Yellowstone River near present-day Custer, Montana. The main combatants were units of the U.S. 7th Cavalry under Lieutenant Colonel George Armstrong Custer, and Native Americans from the village of the Hunkpapa medicine man, Sitting Bull, many of whom would clash with Custer again approximately three years later at the Battle of the Little Big Horn.

zh.s: 皮斯博顿战役又称黄石河战役，于1873年8月11日在黄石河沿岸、今蒙大拿州卡斯特附近爆发，交战双方是美国陆军与苏族。主要参战部队是乔治·阿姆斯特朗·卡斯特中校率领的美国第七骑兵团，以及坐牛药师（洪克帕帕族）所在村庄的原住民战士；约三年后，他们中的许多人又在小比格霍恩战役中与卡斯特交战。

en.s: The Battle of Waterberg (Battle of Ohamakari) took place on August 11, 1904, at the Waterberg, German South West Africa (modern day Namibia), and was the decisive battle in the Herero uprising.

zh.s: 瓦特贝格战役又称奥哈马卡里战役，于1904年8月11日在德属西南非洲（今纳米比亚）的瓦特贝格爆发，是赫雷罗人起义中的决定性战役。

en.s: The Malleson mission or British intervention in Transcaspia was a military action by a small autonomous force of British Indian troops, led by General Wilfrid Malleson, operating against Bolshevik forces over large distances in Transcaspia (modern Turkmenistan) between August 1918 and April 1919, in the context of the Allied intervention in the Russian Civil War.

zh.s: 马莱森任务又称英国干预外里海行动，是一次军事行动，由威尔弗里德·马莱森将军率领一支规模较小、可独立行动的英属印度部队，在外里海（今土库曼斯坦）广阔地区对抗布尔什维克部队，行动持续于1918年8月至1919年4月，属于协约国干预俄国内战的一部分。

en.s: The Constitution of the German Reich (German: Die Verfassung des Deutschen Reichs), usually known as the Weimar Constitution (Weimarer Verfassung), was the constitution that governed Germany during the Weimar Republic era. The constitution created a federal semi-presidential republic with a parliament, the Reichstag, that was elected by universal suffrage using proportional representation. The appointed Reichsrat represented the interests of the federal states.
en.n: Germany's Weimar Constitution is signed into law.

zh.s: 《德意志帝国宪法》（德语：Die Verfassung des Deutschen Reichs），通常称为《魏玛宪法》（Weimarer Verfassung），是魏玛共和国时期德国的宪法。宪法设立了联邦制半总统制共和国，议会为通过普选和比例代表制选出的帝国议会。由各联邦州任命的帝国参议院则代表各州利益。
zh.n: 德国《魏玛宪法》正式签署成为法律。

en.s: The Latvian–Soviet Peace Treaty, also known as the Treaty of Riga, was signed on 11 August 1920 by representatives of the Republic of Latvia and Soviet Russia. It officially ended the Latvian War of Independence. In Article II of the treaty, Soviet Russia recognised the independence of Latvia as inviolable "for all future time".

zh.s: 《拉脱维亚—苏俄和平条约》又称《里加条约》，于1920年8月11日由拉脱维亚共和国和苏维埃俄国代表签署，正式结束拉脱维亚独立战争。条约第二条规定，苏维埃俄国承认拉脱维亚的独立“永远不可侵犯”。

en.s: Sanjurjada (Spanish: [saŋxuɾˈxaða]) was a military coup staged in Spain on August 10, 1932. It was aimed at toppling the government but not necessarily at toppling the Spanish Republic. Following brief clashes it was easily suppressed in Madrid. Hardly any action was recorded elsewhere except Seville, where local rebel commander general José Sanjurjo took control for some 24 hours but acknowledged defeat when faced with resolute governmental response.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 圣胡尔霍政变是1932年8月10日在西班牙发动的一场军事政变，旨在推翻政府，但未必意在推翻西班牙共和国。短暂交火后，政变在马德里很快被镇压。其他地区几乎没有发生行动，只有塞维利亚例外：当地叛军指挥官何塞·桑胡尔霍将军曾控制该市约24小时，但在政府坚决应对后承认失败。

en.s: The Battle of Mérida saw the Republican militia twice fail to halt the Spanish Army of Africa near the historic town of Mérida early in the Spanish Civil War. The Nationalists beat the Republicans from the city on 10 August 1936 and secured control the following day, allowing General Juan Yagüe to surround and capture neighbouring Badajoz in the Battle of Badajoz several days later.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 西班牙内战初期，共和派民兵两次试图阻止非洲军团在历史名城梅里达附近推进，均未成功。1936年8月10日，国民派将共和派赶出该城，并于次日完全控制梅里达。此后，胡安·亚圭将军得以包围并在数日后的巴达霍斯战役中攻占邻近的巴达霍斯。

en.s: The Battle of Albarracín took place in Albarracín and surrounding areas (Teruel) between July 5 and August 11, 1937, during the Spanish Civil War.

en.s: The Battle of Lake Khasan (Russian: Хасанские бои), also known as the Changkufeng Incident (Chinese and Japanese: 張鼓峰事件; Chinese pinyin: Zhānggǔfēng Shìjiàn; Japanese romaji: Chōkohō Jiken), was an attempted military incursion by Manchukuo, a Japanese puppet state, into territory claimed and controlled by the Soviet Union.

en.s: The Kanalkampf (Channel Battle) was the German term for air operations by the Luftwaffe against the Royal Air Force (RAF) over the English Channel in July 1940, beginning the Battle of Britain during the Second World War. By 25 June, the Allies had been defeated in Western Europe and Scandinavia.

zh.s: “英吉利海峡空战”（德语：Kanalkampf，意为“海峡战役”）是德国对1940年7月德国空军在英吉利海峡上空针对英国皇家空军（RAF）展开的空中行动的称呼，这些行动开启了第二次世界大战期间的不列颠之战。到6月25日，盟军已在西欧和斯堪的纳维亚战败。

en.s: The Battle of Pantoja and Rocafuerte, known also simply as the Battle of Rocafuerte, was a military confrontation between Peru and Ecuador that took place on August 11, 1941, during the Ecuadorian–Peruvian War.

zh.t: 潘托哈与罗卡富埃尔特战役
zh.s: 潘托哈与罗卡富埃尔特战役又称罗卡富埃尔特战役，是秘鲁与厄瓜多尔之间的一场军事冲突，于1941年8月11日在厄瓜多尔—秘鲁战争期间爆发。

en.s: The Battle of Kalach took place between the German Sixth Army and elements of the Soviet Stalingrad Front between July 25 and August 11, 1942. The Soviets deployed the 62nd and 64th Armies in a Don River bridgehead west of Kalach with the intent of impeding the German advance on Stalingrad. In the initial period of the battle, the Germans attacked and managed to surround part of the 62nd Army.

zh.s: 卡拉奇战役于1942年7月25日至8月11日在德国第六集团军与苏联斯大林格勒方面军部分部队之间进行。苏军在卡拉奇以西的顿河桥头堡部署了第62和第64集团军，意图阻止德军向斯大林格勒推进。战役初期，德军发起进攻，并成功包围了第62集团军的一部分。

en.s: Operation Boomerang was a partially successful air raid by the United States Army Air Forces' (USAAF) XX Bomber Command against oil refining facilities in Japanese-occupied Dutch East Indies during World War II. The attack took place on the night of 10/11 August 1944 and involved attempts to bomb an oil refinery at Palembang and lay mines to interdict the Musi River.

zh.s: 回旋镖行动是第二次世界大战期间，美国陆军航空军第二十轰炸机司令部对日本占领的荷属东印度群岛炼油设施发动的一次空袭，行动取得部分成功。空袭于1944年8月10日至11日夜间进行，包括试图轰炸巨港的一处炼油厂，并在穆西河布雷以阻断航运。

en.s: The defense of the Wola cemeteries consisted of defensive battles in the area of Powązki and Okopowa Street in Warsaw, conducted by soldiers of the Home Army's Kedyw during the Warsaw Uprising. From August 6 to 11, 1944, the units of the Radosław Group fiercely defended the cemetery zone in Wola.

zh.s: 华沙起义期间，波兰家乡军“基迪夫”部队在华沙波翁兹基和奥科波瓦街一带进行了防御作战，史称沃拉墓园防御战。1944年8月6日至11日，拉多斯瓦夫集团的部队顽强守卫沃拉墓园区。

en.t: Hussein bin Talal is proclaimed King of Jordan
en.s: Hussein bin Talal (Arabic: الحسين بن طلال; 14 November 1935 – 7 February 1999) was King of Jordan from 1952 until his death in 1999. A member of the Hashemite dynasty, he is regarded as a 40th-generation descendant of the Islamic prophet Muhammad. Hussein was born in Amman as the eldest child of Talal bin Abdullah and Zein al-Sharaf bint Jamil.

zh.t: 侯赛因·本·塔拉勒被宣布为约旦国王
zh.s: 侯赛因·本·塔拉勒（阿拉伯语：الحسين بن طلال；1935年11月14日—1999年2月7日）于1952年至1999年去世前担任约旦国王。他是哈希姆王朝成员，被认为是伊斯兰先知穆罕默德的第40代后裔。侯赛因出生于安曼，是塔拉勒·本·阿卜杜拉与扎因·谢拉夫·宾特·贾米勒的长子。

en.t: Indian annexation of Dadra and Nagar Haveli
en.s: The Indian annexation of Dadra and Nagar Haveli was the process in which the territories of Dadra and Nagar Haveli passed from Portuguese rule to independent rule, with Indian allegiance, in 1954. Dadra and Nagar Haveli were small undefended Portuguese overseas territories, part of Portuguese India ever since they were handed over by the Maratha Empire after the Treaty of 1779.

zh.t: 印度吞并达德拉和纳加尔哈维利
zh.s: 1954年，达德拉和纳加尔哈维利脱离葡萄牙统治，成为拥有独立自治、同时效忠印度的领土，这是印度吞并这两地的过程。达德拉和纳加尔哈维利原是葡属印度内小而未设防的海外领地，自1779年条约签署后由马拉塔帝国移交葡萄牙，之后一直属于葡属印度。

en.t: Sheremetyevo International Airport, the second-largest airport in Russia, opens
en.s: Alexander S. Pushkin Sheremetyevo International Airport (Internal code: ШРМ, IATA: SVO, ICAO: UUEE), more commonly known as Sheremetyevo International Airport or simply Sheremetyevo is the busiest of the four international airports that serve the city of Moscow. It is the busiest airport in Russia and the post-Soviet states, as well as the ninth-busiest airport in Europe. Originally built as a military airbase, Sheremetyevo was converted into a civilian airport in 1959.

zh.t: 谢列梅捷沃国际机场启用
zh.s: 谢列梅捷沃国际机场（内部代码：ШРМ；IATA代码：SVO；ICAO代码：UUEE）全称亚历山大·S·普希金谢列梅捷沃国际机场，通常简称谢列梅捷沃机场，是服务莫斯科的四座国际机场中最繁忙的一座。它也是俄罗斯和后苏联国家中最繁忙的机场，以及欧洲第九繁忙的机场。机场最初是军事空军基地，1959年改为民用机场。

en.t: Chad was granted independence on 11 August 1960 with the PPT's leader, François Tombalbaye, an ethnic Sara, as its first president
en.s: Chad, officially the Republic of Chad, is a landlocked country in Central Africa. It is bordered by Libya to the north, Sudan to the east, the Central African Republic to the south, Cameroon to the southwest, Nigeria to the southwest (at Lake Chad), and Niger to the west. Chad has a population of 20 million, of which 1.6 million live in the capital and largest city of N'Djamena.

zh.t: 乍得于1960年8月11日获准独立，人民进步党领导人、萨拉族人弗朗索瓦·托姆巴尔巴耶出任首任总统
zh.s: 乍得正式名称为乍得共和国，是中非内陆国家。北邻利比亚，东接苏丹，南接中非共和国，西南与喀麦隆接壤；在乍得湖一带还与尼日利亚接壤，西邻尼日尔。乍得人口为2,000万，其中160万人住在首都兼最大城市恩贾梅纳。

en.s: The 1962 FA Charity Shield was the 40th FA Charity Shield, an annual football match played between the winners of the previous season's Football League and FA Cup competitions. The match took place on 11 August 1962 at Portman Road in Ipswich, and was played between 1961–62 Football League champions Ipswich Town and 1961–62 FA Cup winners Tottenham Hotspur.

en.s: Vostok 3 (Russian: Восток-3, lit. 'Orient 3' or 'East 3') and Vostok 4 (Восток-4, 'Orient 4' or 'East 4') were Soviet space program flights in August 1962, intended to determine the ability of the human body to function in conditions of weightlessness, test the ground control capability to launch and manage two separate, concurrent flights, and test the endurance of the Vostok 3KA spacecraft over longer flights. Cosmonaut Andriyan Nikolayev orbited the Earth 64 times in Vostok 3 over nearly four days in space, August 11–15, 1962, a feat which would not be matched by NASA until the Gemini program (1965–1966).

zh.s: 东方3号（俄语：Восток-3，意为“东方3号”）和东方4号（Восток-4）是苏联航天计划于1962年8月执行的飞行任务，旨在研究人体在失重状态下的适应能力、测试地面控制人员同时发射和管理两次独立飞行的能力，并检验东方3KA飞船执行较长时间飞行的耐久性。东方3号航天员安德里扬·尼古拉耶夫于1962年8月11日至15日在太空飞行近四天，绕地球64圈；直到美国双子星计划（1965—1966年），美国航天员才达到这一纪录。

en.s: Operation Chicago Peak was a joint U.S. Army and Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN) military operation during the Vietnam War designed to keep pressure on the People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) units in the A Sầu Valley and prevent them from mounting any attacks on the neighboring coastal provinces.

en.t: At the 1520 Sedgwick Avenue apartment building in The Bronx, New York, DJ Kool Herc hosts a house party widely considered to mark the birthplace of hip-hop culture and music. DJ Kool Herc demonstrates a new technique of beat juggling and Coke La Rock performs a new style of vocal performance called rapping
en.s: 1520 Sedgwick Avenue is a 102-unit apartment building in the Morris Heights neighborhood of the Bronx in New York City. Described in The New York Times as a long-time "haven for working class families", it has been historically accepted as the birthplace of hip hop. The first mortgages for units at 1520 Sedgwick were made in 1967.

zh.t: DJ Kool Herc在纽约布朗克斯区塞奇威克大道1520号公寓楼举办家庭派对，该活动普遍被视为嘻哈文化与音乐的诞生地。DJ Kool Herc展示了新的节拍混合技巧，Coke La Rock则首创一种称为说唱的口语表演风格
zh.s: 纽约市布朗克斯区莫里斯高地社区的塞奇威克大道1520号是一栋拥有102套住宅的公寓楼。《纽约时报》称它长期以来是“工薪家庭的避风港”，人们历来将这里视为嘻哈文化的发源地。该楼住宅的首批抵押贷款于1967年发放。

en.s: The 27th Locarno Film Festival was held from 1 to 11 August 1974 in Locarno, Switzerland. The festival showcased films from 17 countries. A retrospective of Swiss cinema was organized and sent by ex-artistic director Freddy Buache. One film which received considerable attention was Die Rote Pest [The Red Plague] (1938), a Swiss film that, at the time, was considered anonymously created and was theorized to be produced by ultra-conservative bankers and Nazis.

zh.s: 第27届洛迦诺电影节于1974年8月1日至11日在瑞士洛迦诺举行，展映了来自17个国家的电影。前艺术总监弗雷迪·布阿什组织并寄送了一场瑞士电影回顾展。瑞士电影《Die Rote Pest》（《红色瘟疫》，1938年）受到广泛关注；当时人们认为该片是匿名创作的，也有人推测它由极端保守派银行家和纳粹制作。

en.s: The 1979 FA Charity Shield was the 57th Charity Shield, an annual English football match played between the winners of the previous season's Football League and FA Cup. It was held at Wembley Stadium on 11 August 1979. The match was contested by Liverpool, champions of the 1978–79 Football League and Arsenal, who beat Manchester United in the final of the 1978–79 FA Cup. Watched by a crowd of 92,800, Liverpool won the match 3–1. This was Arsenal's tenth Charity Shield appearance and Liverpool's ninth. Arsenal made no changes to the first team which played in the FA Cup Final the previous season, whereas for Liverpool new signing Avi Cohen started on the bench.

zh.s: 1979年英格兰足总慈善盾杯是第57届慈善盾杯，这项英格兰年度足球赛由上赛季足球联赛和足总杯冠军参赛，于1979年8月11日在温布利球场举行。对阵双方是1978—79赛季足球联赛冠军利物浦和足总杯冠军阿森纳；阿森纳在决赛中击败了曼彻斯特联。现场观众达92,800人，利物浦以3比1获胜。这是阿森纳第十次参加慈善盾杯、利物浦第九次参加。阿森纳沿用了上赛季足总杯决赛的首发阵容；利物浦的新援阿维·科恩则坐在替补席上。

en.s: The 1979 Soviet Cup final was a football match that took place at the Lenin's Central Stadium, Moscow on 11 August 1979. The match was the 38th soviet cup final and was contested between Dynamo Moscow and Dinamo Tbilisi. Previous cup holders Dynamo Kyiv were eliminated in Quarter-finals by CSKA Moscow. Dinamo Tbilisi defeated the opponent on penalties and won the cup for the second time.

zh.s: 1979年苏联杯决赛于1979年8月11日在莫斯科列宁中央体育场举行，是第38届苏联杯决赛。参赛双方是莫斯科迪纳摩和第比利斯迪纳摩。卫冕冠军基辅迪纳摩在四分之一决赛中被莫斯科中央陆军淘汰。第比利斯迪纳摩在点球大战中击败对手，第二次夺得苏联杯。

en.s: The Battle of Bir Anzarane was a significant military confrontation between the armed forces of the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic, represented by the Polisario Front, and the Moroccan Armed Forces. The confrontation took place in the oasis of Bir Anzarane, situated in Western Sahara, a territory that is the subject of a claim by both parties.

zh.s: 比尔安扎拉内战役是西撒哈拉阿拉伯民主共和国（由波利萨里奥阵线代表）与摩洛哥武装部队之间的一场重要军事冲突。战斗发生在西撒哈拉比尔安扎拉内的一处绿洲；西撒哈拉是双方均提出主权主张的地区。

en.s: On 11 August 1979, a mid-air collision occurred over the Ukrainian SSR, near the city of Dniprodzerzhynsk (now Kamianske). The aircraft involved were both Tupolev Tu-134As on scheduled domestic passenger flights, operated by Aeroflot. All 178 people aboard both aircraft died in the accident. The official Soviet aviation board investigation of the accident concluded that the crash was caused by "mistakes and violations" made by air traffic controllers.

zh.t: 1979年第聂伯罗捷尔任斯克空中相撞事故
zh.s: 1979年8月11日，两架飞机在乌克兰苏维埃社会主义共和国上空、第聂伯罗捷尔任斯克（今卡缅斯科耶）附近相撞。两架飞机均为图波列夫Tu-134A，执行定期国内客运航班，由苏联民航（Aeroflot）运营。事故造成两机上178人全部遇难。苏联航空事故官方调查委员会认定，事故由空中交通管制员的“错误和违规行为”造成。

en.s: Pan Am Flight 830 was a scheduled international flight from New Tokyo International Airport (now known as Narita International Airport) in Tokyo, Japan, to Los Angeles International Airport in Los Angeles, California via Honolulu International Airport in Hawaii. On August 11, 1982, the Boeing 747-121 serving the flight, nicknamed Clipper Ocean Rover, was en route to Hawaii when the airplane was damaged by a bomb that had been placed on board.

zh.s: 泛美航空830号班机是一趟定期国际航班，从东京新东京国际机场（今成田国际机场）飞往洛杉矶国际机场，途中经停夏威夷檀香山国际机场。1982年8月11日，执飞该航班的波音747-121型飞机当时名为“海洋探险者号”，正飞往夏威夷途中，机上一枚炸弹爆炸，导致飞机受损。

en.t: We begin bombing in five minutes
en.s: "We begin bombing in five minutes" is the last sentence of a controversial, off-the-record joke made by the president of the United States, Ronald Reagan, in 1984 during the Cold War. While preparing for a scheduled radio address from his vacation home in California, Reagan joked with those present about outlawing and bombing Russia. The joke was not broadcast live, but was recorded and later leaked to the public.
en.n: "We begin bombing in five minutes": United States President Ronald Reagan, while running for re-election, jokes while preparing to make his weekly Saturday address on National Public Radio.

zh.s: “我们五分钟后开始轰炸”是美国总统罗纳德·里根1984年冷战期间开的一句有争议的非公开玩笑的最后一句话。当时他正在加利福尼亚州度假住所准备一场预定的广播讲话，和在场的人开玩笑说要取缔俄罗斯并轰炸俄罗斯。这段玩笑没有在直播中播出，但被录了下来，后来泄露给公众。
zh.n: 罗纳德·里根正在竞选连任，在准备为美国国家公共广播电台录制每周六例行讲话时开玩笑说：“我们五分钟后开始轰炸”。

en.s: Alan Greenspan (March 6, 1926 – June 22, 2026) was an American economist who served as the 13th chair of the Federal Reserve from 1987 to 2006. He worked as a private adviser and provided consulting for firms through his company, Greenspan Associates LLC. First nominated to the Federal Reserve by President Ronald Reagan in August 1987, Greenspan was reappointed at successive four-year intervals until retiring in January 2006, after the second-longest tenure in the position, behind only William McChesney Martin.

zh.s: 艾伦·格林斯潘（1926年3月6日—2026年6月22日）是美国经济学家，1987年至2006年担任第13任美联储主席。他通过自己的公司格林斯潘顾问有限责任公司担任私人顾问，为企业提供咨询服务。1987年8月，他首次获总统罗纳德·里根提名进入美联储，此后每隔四年连任，直至2006年1月退休。他的任期是该职位历史上第二长，仅次于威廉·麦克切斯尼·马丁。

zh.s: 《伦与史丁比秀》也简称《伦与史丁比》，是美国动画喜剧电视剧，由约翰·克里克法鲁西为尼克儿童频道创作。剧情围绕伦·霍克和史丁比的倒霉经历展开：伦是一只情绪不稳定、精神错乱的吉娃娃，史丁比则是一只善良但不太聪明的曼岛猫。

en.t: The Mall of America in Bloomington, Minnesota opens. At the time, it is the largest shopping mall in the United States
en.s: Mall of America (MOA) is a super-regional shopping mall and entertainment complex in Bloomington, Minnesota. Located within the Minneapolis–Saint Paul metropolitan area, the mall lies southeast of the junction of Interstate 494 and Minnesota State Highway 77, north of the Minnesota River, and across the Interstate from the Minneapolis–Saint Paul International Airport.

zh.s: 美国购物中心（MOA）是位于明尼苏达州布卢明顿的大型区域购物中心和娱乐综合体，地处明尼阿波利斯—圣保罗都会区。购物中心位于494号州际公路与明尼苏达州77号公路交汇处东南方、明尼苏达河以北，并与明尼阿波利斯—圣保罗国际机场隔州际公路相望。

en.s: The 1992 DFB-Supercup, known as the Panasonic DFB-Supercup for sponsorship purposes, was the 6th DFB-Supercup, an annual football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Bundesliga and DFB-Pokal competitions. zh.s: 1992年德国超级杯因赞助商而又称“松下德国超级杯”，是第六届赛事。这项年度足球赛由上赛季德甲联赛和德国杯冠军参赛。比赛在汉诺威的下萨克森球场举行，参赛双方是联赛冠军斯图加特和德国杯冠军汉诺威96。斯图加特以3比1获胜，首次夺得超级杯。

en.s: The Insurgency in Ogaden was an armed conflict that took place from 1992 to 2018. It was waged by nationalist and Islamist Somali insurgent groups seeking self-determination for the region, primarily the Ogaden National Liberation Front (ONLF) and Al-Itihaad Al-Islamiya (AIAI). The war in the region began in 1992, when the Ethiopian government attacked AIAI in an attempt to suppress the growth of the organization.

en.s: The 1995 Russell Hill subway accident was a deadly train crash that occurred in Toronto, Ontario, Canada on Yonge-University-Spadina line of the Toronto subway on August 11, 1995. Three people were killed and 30 were taken to hospital with injuries when one train rear-ended another train. The subway line was shut down for five days following the incident. Investigations found that human error and a design flaw in the mechanical safety devices caused this accident. It remains the deadliest accident in a rapid transit system in Canadian history.

zh.s: 1995年罗素山地铁事故于1995年8月11日在加拿大安大略省多伦多的央街—大学—士巴丹拿线发生，是一起致命列车相撞事故。一列列车追尾另一列，造成3人死亡、30人受伤送医。事故后该地铁线路停运五天。调查发现，事故由人为失误和机械安全装置的设计缺陷共同造成。它至今仍是加拿大快速交通系统中死亡人数最多的事故。

en.s: The 1996 Indian Federation Cup final was the 19th final of the Indian Federation Cup, the top knock-out competition in India, and was contested between Kolkata giant East Bengal and Dempo of Goa on 11 August 1996. East Bengal won the final 2–1 courtesy of a Golden goal by Raman Vijayan in the extra-time to claim their fourth Federation Cup title.

en.s: The Terry Gordy Memorial Show was a professional wrestling memorial event produced by the Legends of Pro Wrestling (LPW) promotion, which took place on August 11, 2001 at the Boutwell Auditorium in Birmingham, Alabama. The event was held in honor of Terry "Bam Bam" Gordy who had died of a heart attack at his home outside Chattanooga, Tennessee the previous month. Promoter Linda Marx Keebles promised that 20% of the proceeds would be donated to Gordy's family to help cover funeral costs and guaranteed at least a $1,000 donation. Nine professional wrestling matches were featured on the event's card, with two including championships.

en.s: The 2002 FA Community Shield (also known as The FA Community Shield in partnership with McDonald's for sponsorship reasons) was the 80th FA Community Shield, an annual English football match played between the winners of the previous season's Premier League and FA Cup. en.s: The Battle of Tskhinvali (2008) (Georgian: ცხინვალის ბრძოლა; Russian: Бои за Цхинвали) was a fight for the city of Tskhinvali, the capital of the self-proclaimed Republic of South Ossetia. It was the only major battle in the Russo-Georgian War. Georgian ground troops entered the city on early 8 August 2008. After the three-day fierce fighting with South Ossetian militia and Russian troops, Georgian troops finally withdrew from the city on the evening of 10 August.

en.s: Operation Scorched Earth (Arabic: عملية الأرض المحروقة) was the code-name of a Yemeni military offensive in the Saada Governorate that began in August 2009. It marked the fifth wave of violence during the ongoing insurgency by the Houthis against the government. In November 2009, the conflict spread across the border into neighboring Saudi Arabia. en.s: Bloodymania 7 was a professional wrestling pay-per-view produced by Juggalo Championship Wrestling (JCW), which was only available online. It took place on August 11, 2013 at Hog Rock in Cave-In-Rock, Illinois. Professional wrestling is a type of sports entertainment in which theatrical events are combined with a competitive sport. en.s: The 2013 Festival de las Máscaras (Spanish for "Festival of the Mask") was a major lucha libre event produced and scripted by the Mexican International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG) professional wrestling promotion on August 11, 2013. The show was held in Arena Naucalpan, Naucalpan, State of Mexico, which is IWRG's primary venue. At the 2013 event Avisman, El Hijo del Diablo, El Hijo de Pirata Morgan, Universo 2000 and Veneno all wore their masks again after having lost Luchas de Apuestas, or "bet matches", in the past and thus lost the rights to wear their mask.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Mali on 28 July 2013, with a second round run-off held on 11 August. en.s: General elections were held in Zambia on 11 August 2016 to elect the President and National Assembly. A constitutional referendum was held alongside the elections, with proposals to amend the bill of rights and Article 79. President Edgar Lungu, previously elected in January 2015 to finish the term of Michael Sata, who died in office, was re-elected to a full five-year term when he scored above the 50% + 1 mark of the vote, defeating opposition leader Hakainde Hichilema. Lungu's Patriotic Front also won a majority in the National Assembly for the first time, winning 80 of the 156 elected seats.

zh.s: 赞比亚于2016年8月11日举行大选，选出总统和国民议会议员。选举期间还举行了宪法公投，提案涉及修改《权利法案》和第79条。总统埃德加·伦古此前于2015年1月当选，接替在任内去世的迈克尔·萨塔完成其任期。这次伦古得票超过“50%加1票”门槛，击败反对派领袖哈凯恩德·希奇莱马，成功连任完整的五年任期。伦古领导的爱国阵线也首次在国民议会赢得多数，取得156个民选席位中的80席。

en.s: The 2025 Arthabaska provincial by-election was held on August 11, 2025. The seat was represented by Eric Lefebvre of the CAQ until he resigned on 18 March 2025 to run for the partially-overlapping federal riding of Richmond—Arthabaska in the 2025 Canadian federal election. In an attempt to win a seat in the National Assembly, Conservative Party of Quebec leader Éric Duhaime ran as a candidate in the by-election; he finished second behind the Parti Québécois' Alex Boissonneault.
